notes.title: Our new game network SWGIO.COM
notes.notes:
We've had a lot of trouble getting seen on steam. They seem to push us to the back and not let us get much visibility. So we've created our own gaming network that lets you play games on your phone without downloading them, compete with others directly or for high score, co op, and post social posts.

Our network is run and moderated by humans, not algorithms. And we curate what makes it based on our own criteria that are determined by actual people. Also there are no bots on our network, unlike certain bird themed networks.

We hope you join us in this adventure to take our games and our community to the next level, reach out to me @michaelplzno if you want info or an invite to our new space for games!

Here is our video about the new update:

notes.title: Meet The Rocket Surgeons
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/f45276e52aa556e90b4a28e15e7bee3f01785834.png[/img]

MatchyGotchy happened as a result of Matchy Star. While working with Matchy Star, we wanted to give these cute characters a life of their own. This is where the idea of interacting with them as virtual pets came into the Matchyverse.

Matchy Star is the original character, and he explores the Alpha System where he meets all the other stars on the way. Originally called gems, as part of a match 3 design, eventually they all became characters instead and we call them Stars now thanks to MatchyGotchy.

The stars were given a purpose in space, they want to grow to become rocket surgeons. It comes from that quirky mix of ‘rocket science’ and ‘brain surgery’, commonly used as a light hearted and fun take joke to suggest high intelligence or higher qualifications. Each of their own have their specific jobs though, and also their own personalities.

Just like any virtual pet experience, they have their own growth and different phases of it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/63a4e80afcbdea600e26a46cb77310d45d387cc1.png[/img]
[b]Smol Egg[/b]
We decided to make the Stars hatch as a fond reference to tamagotchies from back then. There is no care to the egg, as we initially intended to make MatchyGotchy a short and intuitive experience to introduce the characters. In MatchyGotchy, it’s just a transitional phase that requires no care taking – we are revisiting this concept for MatchyGotchy Z!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/bdcf4fb16a00fde764f785af6684a612b854097c.png[/img]
[b]Tiny Baby.[/b]
Stars are born without any outfit, or any skills. They are smart cookies though, so they are drawn to build ships in order to become a rocket surgeon – they slowly pick up on productivity as they grow up. At first, it’s a learning curve, just about the same it is for the player learning how to take care of their stars.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/60263f43f50f2bc4509e904115671aa2018bfafb.png[/img]
[b]Awkward Teenager.[/b]
The are halfway into full productivity and job purpose. Once they level up, they don’t only grow in size but also acquire part of their main outfit. It knd of looks a tad off, which is the reason why it fits so well the idea of being a teenager in those awkward years while growing up. At this stage they require a bit less of undivided attention but they get distracted and sick much easier.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/7f5b6432b717eca930b7c60a50c34e00c56b7099.png[/img]
[b]Rocket Surgeon.[/b]
They finally reach their normal size, full clothing, and a range of productivity which they do not while babies. As they continue to work, they peak in speed at their job – they get better and now you can use your stars to build up ships to get to Xanadu. They become a bit more independent and work their very best.

Just like any tamagotchi-like experience, they need food and care to grow. They can also get sick, they sleep – and in MatchyGotchy, they can also die with bad care. We originally designed six actions, food and snacks, a traditional left/right game, cleaning, health and selfies. Cycling through these as needed will allow your Star to be fully productive and grow as they should to become Rocket Surgeons. Including selfies, they are part of the entertainment factor Stars need.

There are a total of seven Stars, and each star has a particular task as a rocket surgeon. Let’s meet the Rocket Surgeons:

[b]MATCHY STAR AS AN ALL-DIMENSIONAL MASTER SHIPWRIGHT[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/73a4d24fe985e8d3d3b5db0035a21d4dee57ada6.png[/img]
Matchy Star is an engineer extraordinaire. Ready to use mathematics and a trusty graphing calculator to explore the cosmos, Matchy is happy, upbeat, and full of unbridled contagious enthusiasm. Matchy’s positive nature inspires other stars to achieve nerdy heights.

[b]SPACEY GALAXY AS DAUNTLESS ELEGANT DIPLOMAT[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/c81b83c128595cea4d7bc0c4a7a7135c99773a0b.png[/img]
Spacey Galaxy once managed to negotiate a truce in the Klatu Nebula by strategically sneezing at exactly the right moment. Never shying away from the personal touch, Spacey once took a galactic ruler’s space dog to the groomers all in the name of peace.

[b]SPEEDY SPUTNIK AS INTERSTELLAR SHIPMENT MANAGER[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/de87e80980740001f4bac6505682f26af6216f0c.png[/img]
Speedy Sputnik knows the routes though space to get anywhere fast. Speedy managed to change the speed of light for a few hours just to make sure a delivery got to its destination on time. Always out for a promotion, this Sputnik dreams of doing deliveries for Matchy Mart.

[b]DOCTOR UFO SPACE PHYSICIAN MD[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/42678577dfcac2c6a5af8b83c64bf75247c49f02.png[/img]
Doctor UFO attended space medical school at the prestigious Space University of Medicine and Shoe Cobbling. Don’t let the good doctor’s derpy demeanor fool you, this UFO is capable of diagnosing a multitude of diseases by sense of smell alone!

[b]PIRATE PLANET AS A MIGHTY BOOTY HUNTER [/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/92457278beac66383af3f17b3c1922b5f93e9691.png[/img]
Pirate Planet is so grumpy that just scowling can intimidate enemies into surrendering their valuables without the need to say a word. Pirate Planet is a noble pirate, only stealing things the rapscallion really wants but doesn’t have and can’t afford.

[b]LOONY LANDER AS QUAINT ALIEN BOTANIST[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/941830236314a5030c850f5dafb84e4003693d2d.png[/img]
Loony Lander realized an internal talent for botany by managing to plant a spare microchip which grew into a tree that had tiny little computers on it. The computers were too small to use but they taste great!

[b]GURU MOON AS ASTROLOGICAL FORECAST SPECIALIST[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/878b28e6c84c8dcea5257c3b8404d40e3c501896.png[/img]
Always one for supernatural coincidences and fortune telling shenanigans, Guru Moon became a Guru by successfully predicting how long the halftime show at the Space Bowl would be every year 5 years in a row down to the second.

Have you played MatchyGotchy yet? You should! It’s fun, it’s cute and it’s also entirely free. If you enjoyed the game, you can support us by leaving a positive review :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/772700/MatchyGotchy/

notes.title: MatchyGotchy Feels!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/bda5317eb0cb17e7570769bb7cc234671f8ca747.png[/img]

It’s been a few months since September big update, I figured it was about time we revisited those big changes.

We launched MatchyGotchy back in January, and ever since we’ve worked on different updates. We have shared seasonal updates like Halloween, and Valentine’s Day, but these changes are often up for two weeks or so and then they’re gone until next year. However, back in September we did a set of big changes which were fully permanent to the game.

From the ‘Big MatchyGotchy Update’ we revisited a lot of user feedback and decided to tweak things around. Some were technical, and most were entirely aesthetic changes. Let’s talk about the most important revisions first.

[b]We included notifications.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/47cc7eddf3cf68f34910f4ecd7c60859cfac5fe2.jpg[/img]

These pop up bubbles show up to help you understand your Star better. At first it’s supposed to guide you through as a tutorial, actions light up yellow to make it easy to follow. Eventually the popups will appear less frequently only to guide you in the right direction if needed.

[b]Party at Xanadu.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/4d30cfaf59e44412ff209cb9d97670af9b9816aa.jpg[/img]

Some people thought the congratulation screen wasn’t enough of a reward at the end of the game, so we decided to include a whole pool party. You can now get a proper score of how well your Stars worked, and also give them a bit of time to relax and have fun after all that hard work. Visiting Xanadu will change the laboratory too, after your visit.

[b]Stars leveling pace changed.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/82996ef528bd2af24d625b06c8137bc70bb72443.jpg[/img]

We tweaked how Stars level. Baby phase only takes three ships and tenage phase takes another six ships – this has to do with the whole notification phase. Also, each pet is capable of different productivity skills, meaning some can produce multiple ships at once. As adults the Stars even produce ships of different colors. And last but not least, leveling includes a more visually noticeable animation to let you know your Star is on its way to become a rocket surgeon.

[b]Sleep is a bit easier.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/8dce849f5d90a88b3d8c6706d8d82420c4bac1cd.jpg[/img]

We heard that this one achievement might have felta bit grindy, so we decided to make it less of a chore to get. Sometimes idle pets will fall asleep when you aren’t using them for up to 5 sleeps. This makes the sleep achievement a bit easier.

These are both visually and technically important, however, there were other changes that were just aesthetic – yet, they add more to the game now.

[b]Hands animation.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/00230ef09d3d8ac2174e62dae29393e46b007627.jpg[/img]

The main game from the free build now has hands instead of buttons. You get to choose which hand the heart is hidden, making the game interaction somewhat more enjoyable. Also the first choice you make is a freebie, guaranteed to get you a heart.

[b]More roaches.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/53bd4c445e74cf812343ff2632b57ac54e4d5f1e.jpg[/img]

Cleaning just got more colorful, and messier! There are different roaches now. Including a swatter to get them.

[b]Stars have different sizes while growing up.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/dfed671842410528958e2ac0914e1fe0aae20b1d.png[/img]

It was a minor aesthetic change, but it sure makes baby photos look extra cute now.

In other updates, mostly technical, cloud save is now available. Soft and hard reset exist. Soft reset clears stars but not your score, whereas hard reset clears all your stars and your score. A lot of new things became part of the game, and also were intended to improve the game experience.

Have you played MatchyGotchy yet? You should! It’s fun, it’s cute and it’s also entirely free. If you enjoyed the game, you can support us by leaving a positive review :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/772700/MatchyGotchy/

notes.title: Matchy Colors and Star Shapes
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/3cbf058e3e25d256c527e5dc3fb6874a6f168d5e.png[/img]

Designing a set of Stars for the Matchyverse required so many iterations I’ve lost track. We needed memorable shapes that stood out and were distinct and they eventually took on personas and characteristics of their own. Here is some more info on how we did it:

We really started from nothing and got a whole universe. At first we were calling these seven just “gems” or “shapes.” It would take months before we realized they were Stars and the Matchyverse was born. Getting the final shapes for the Matchy Star “Stars” took a lot of design work. The first Star, Matchy was pretty straightforward to put together but we needed a set of 7 which meant color and shape differentiation to make it very easy for players to tell which shape was which. For the colors we started with the color palate from Don’t Shoot Yourself which was designed to be bright and vibrant but not to have the colors clash or compete with one another.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/7089ec51f933ab5626124519e76a3c041b83bb4c.png[/img]

The first step was figuring out a set of spacy out of this world shapes that would both fit the theme and also stand out from one another. After Matchy Star, a crescent Moon was a pretty easy choice and I guess the phrase Blue Moon had entered my unconsciousness so I decided to make this Star blue.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/930a8267040f868520dfabf6bb8c0b4a0daff3a5.png[/img]

The basic moon shape took 2 iterations. The first one was a bit too thin and my mom pointed out that it should be a bit beefier to be a cuter shape so I tweaked it and got the final version.

The next idea I had was for a space satellite which was originally orange. It required a lot of simplifications before it became a red sputnik. I had a sputnik character in Speedway Heroes which was part of why the iconic lil’ spud was in my brain and I knew it was a great iconic space related shape so it made it into the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/771dc309ce332aff4157a6836858c32aee6b85f2.png[/img]

Once it was clear the Sputnik would be red, I made a ringed planet that was Orange. By Rotating it 45 degrees it seemed much bigger despite not taking up more texture space:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/a8314f6e280903f7f6e6765418bc3a3b9eb55d9f.png[/img]

The next Star wasn’t so clearly defined so it needed a bunch of iterations. It was supposed to be a galaxy expanding into space. I figured the spokes and points would make it stand out from the rest of the shapes. Getting the number of spokes and their curves took a lot of fidgeting. Some iterations looked like saw blades, others looked like gears.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/0e9b1fdb7fa080c77009063798ad2f56c6999004.png[/img]

I knew I had to have a robot and I guess because of the Android logo I assumed it would be green. We had to compact it a little bit to avoid being too similar to the Android android and changed it to being a “Lander” instead.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/b63f25bd12084b89a5a3bb03f3ef6382cfb2d2b5.png[/img]

The last Star was the most complicated. It was meant to be a space ship before I had the concept of using a set of ships to collect matches:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/e7d4ecf6c6046187c8bfd76399fdb0abd95169c9.png[/img]

Similarly there was going to be a UFO to sow chaos and cause all kinds of trouble but the Ship and the UFO would switch places with the UFO becoming a gem and the Ship traveling above the grid. Its possible to tell what direction the Ship is moving in by looking at it and players needed that to help predict which direction the characters would be moving in.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/09e7d61d0bc3dd835f58e62b90aba71ef4b40507.png[/img]

Thus we got the final Star, a UFO:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/db7888171ebc8bf5b901fe57a10afc15f9e5c696.png[/img]

Even after getting the shapes right, we still had more iterations on the combined colors of everything to make sure different Stars stood out, we would even make the images black and white to see what the different intensities of the colors were to make everything stand out as distinct as possible:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/05251a47bdd0b02de98d348c544af14d6a957c32.png[/img]

Finally Jimp stylized all the Stars and added faces, giving the complete look and completing this epic design task:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/e56215fbe8c24f6be20bdb7c142380262932f78d.png[/img]

Eventually we punched up each Star to have a set of clothing and a profession based on their outfit and even designed personalities for each one that affect how they work in the various Matchy Verse games. It was a long, complex, and difficult process, but the Matchyverse finally has its Stars!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/782430/Matchy_Star/

notes.title: Designing the One and Only Matchy
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/df378c680ddbcd7f473aa6ced02d4d7a80bdac29.png[/img]

Creating an original character felt like I had to create an entire universe, but really it was just one star.

The literal first thing I did on this project was come up with the name Matchy Star. I knew I wanted to do something Sci-Fi, and I knew I wanted a main character that would stand out and really be able to get people behind him. So, the first character I designed was a star shape based on a number of sources.

The process for how I did it was complicated:

The initial star shape for Matchy was a little off set for its perspective and based on the classic Nintendo star icon shape. I wanted an exuberant face and I always had the old meme emoji “Exuberant Bliss” stuck in my head, so I sort of fused the two together. The Nintendo star is a bit less expressive because its not supposed to outshine Mario, but for the Matchyverse, Matchy needed to really be an expressive exuberant character that would communicate with players the feelings that the series is supposed to evoke. Next, I added a black outline that was again not perfectly aligned to add some character. This style of cartoony outline was inspired by the sort of offset lines in Angry Birds.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/8a8f0c6c96901763a92ebbdcb6628fc58467c902.png[/img]

For the next iteration I added some hair and a bit of a sense of vanity and ego that comes with having great hair. This could only mean one source of inspiration, Johnny Bravo:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/ab4394494a9ba98cb5b72567be7d1bccfa4b436c.png[/img]

Of course, as the creative director, I had intended Matchy to have shades. Later iterations would change them to goggles and remove the hair which was sort of a compromise with the people on the team – and Jimp, the artist who did the final designs of Matchy. I don’t like being too firm in imposing my creative direction on the team because it sort of becomes more of a creative dictatorship, and I understand that the team has a say in these things too but here is the SHADE version of Matchy:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/19ab764d42cf9c69de3b33a08f685d3d8e198b63.png[/img]

I did a lot of iterations that involved small tweaks to shapes and shading, but idk where the files went even though I intended to save them. Some of the details were so small even we have a hard time noticing them, sometimes the changes were big and obvious. Designing takes a lot of small tweaks and iterations and sadly a lot of those details will be forever lost. To some extent each change almost felt like aliens were contacting me to help me design the character. Sometimes I’d make a change and have an itch or hear a noise and it would make me think about modifying that change even more. It was sort of surreal to put together the character and I went through 12 iterations that all had differences.

And I suppose no one can escape Simpsons Mania, so I decided to add a nice set of blue pants to complete the look:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/c681be6fbc3ca87a6d1e69b950f74734d9f5af3b.png[/img]

Of course it would take even more work to get the final versions of everything, but this is how the whole thing started. We eventually hired Jimp from Massive Monster, and he added his own lick of paint. We defined the style of eyes and lines based on some feedback from our mailing list from a bunch of options Jimp presented. We also discussed the idea of making Matchy a wizard or redefining the character, but I added some more references to the list to cement the direction including Sponge Bob, Andy the Mechanic from Advance wars, and other spacey characters to define the final direction as an enthusiastic derpy goofball scientist and as a result we got even more iterations:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6856690/c965d346508293e6fba4f3691b03c9d22ca4abdd.png[/img]

It really took a phenomenal amount of work to design this character even though it might seem sort of obvious now that Matchy already exists. I know that Matchy seems like a very clear cohesive simple character, but it was not at all obvious or clear on how to land at this end result, it took a lot of work!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/782430/Matchy_Star/][h1]☆ You can wishlist Matchy Star right here on Steam ☆ [/h1][/url]

notes.title: Matchy Crafts!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31716437/1efa0be86362ab4c1a64ff8cf963cef9422647e3.png[/img]

When we explored ideas to have a DLC for MatchyGotchy, we first thought of what most developers already offer: a cosmetic pack of some sort. However, we had this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/888220/MatchyGotchy_Z/]whole new game coming called MatchyGotchy Z[/url], so we felt this might fall short in comparison – one cute hat is no match for a monster store with more than just hats. We opted to consider a different idea, like paper crafts.

MatchyGotchy was originally planned as an entry point to the Matchyverse. We have already designed a bunch of fun game ideas around Matchy Star, so the idea of paper toys would fit in with the whole theme of casual and fun.  Paper models are easy to put together, they are original to the game aesthetics, and most important of all, they are quite accessible to buy too. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/888210/MatchyGotchy_Pack/]That's what MachyGotchy Pack is all about.[/url]

In MatchyGotchy Pack there is a digital comic called “Game Development Stories” in which I share the story of how Matchy Star happened as some sort of a silly comic / fairy tale in which Sporkie, Silverware Games logo pet, tells the story to Stardust, MatchyGotchy Z new companion.

Regarding the paper designs – It has a paper craft booklet, with the profiles of all seven stars: Matchy Star, Spacey Galaxy, Speedy Sputnik, Doctor UFO, Guru Moon, and Pirate Planet. I designed it as a tiny little book that closes into a tiny box and opens as an accordion. Also included, there is an original paper model of MatchyGotchy laboratory, and in here you can swap all seven pets whenever you want. And all of this comes with a Silverware Games paper stand as well, so you can display your MatchyGotchy diorama on your desk.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31716437/61051148a76156829e9c140d32bafc7c253c9dad.png[/img]

And last but not least – it includes a MatchyGotchy Manual, a digital PDF that you can print too if you’d like. It brings a total of 12 pages of Matchy colorful cuteness showcasing the paper models, studio notes, and a thank you note from us silly developers.

And speaking of MatchyGotchy Pack, Polarized Moon made a Casual Friday video named Crafting Stars, where he put together the entire paper set as he recorded it all, step by step –  quite helpful as a video guide to make the paper models. Every printable PDF in MatchyGotchy Pack has instructions, but Polarized Moon’s video and commentary are quite priceless. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=35MVoMvrnVI

Polarized Moon is a lovely friend of the Matchyverse community, supporting indie games one video at a time. [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCA3wMdxgb50C5P5Scb_5olw]You should stop by his YouTube channel,[/url] he is that sort of good and kind hearted people we very much need in this world. 

I am quite thankful that Silverware Games would want to explore MatchyGotchy paper designs. It was even more of a pleasant surprise to realize there is interest in unusual fun like paper toys, which means we will be making more for sure. [b]We will be providing some paper designs for people who sign up to our mailing list to practice[/b], with the idea to ease people into the wonder that is paper crafts - now Matchy crafts.

[b]If you would like to support us while we continue to make games, then please consider checking out MatchyGotchy Pack right here on Steam![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/888210/MatchyGotchy_Pack/

notes.title: Next Chapter of the Matchyverse Adventure
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31716437/1eaa59634377c749e44436ebbf9048a917c0d0ef.png[/img]

Hello citizens of the Matchyverse! After months of hard work we can finally show all the awesome things we have got for you!

We’ve been working all kinds of new fun for you so let’s split the good news in three big chunks:

[h1]First, MatchyGotchy gets a huge update.[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31716437/50e2a59a6a6619522964faa62d203029990de6a3.jpg[/img]

We included cloud save, a tutorial to make console actions clearer, notifications to understand your star better and you can actually have an intergalactic pool party for all those who finished the game. We have a log of all the tweaks and changes in detail right here on the steam forums.

[h1]Second, introducing MatchyGotchy Pack![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31716437/e53a33569cd2faa893cb95d7120c09a178bd9bf0.jpg[/img]

At Silverware Games we want to provide fun experiences hoping to invite everyone to reconnect with that childlike wonder with us. Every day can be stressful and sometimes difficult, that is why we think it is important not to lose that sense of awe to find joy in little things in life. That’s why we decided to provide a creative opportunity to explore that inner child in all of us, so we designed a bunch of original cute papercraft models to continue to enjoy MatchyGotchy.

They are fairly simple to put together, all it takes it’s a bit of time, scissors and glue! This papercraft is a perfect activity to do with family or by yourself. There is a laboratory diorama, a character booklet and a cute stand to display either of them on your desktop. And by purchasing the DLC you are supporting the studio allowing us to continue to offer more creative opportunities for fun, including video games coming to Steam. Besides the paper models, there is a manual pack that includes information about what the DLC brings along a comic that will tell you the story of how we decided to come up with a tamagotchi like experience like MatchyGotchy.

[h1]Third and finally, MatchyGotchy Z is coming![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31716437/674ac7e02bd0f6b8f3dc49ef204092ffa3a5ddd2.jpg[/img]

We were working on a gigantic update for MatchyGotchy, hoping that the DLC would allow us to include Steam Cards like we always wanted, but we learned there were some money requirements to these that we considered a bit too steep – so ultimately decided to put all this new content, and hopefully the cards, under a much more reasonable price tag. That’s how the idea of MatchyGotchy Z came along, and it has given us the opportunity to do so much more than what we originally intended for the free MatchyGotchy version.

There is so much more content already done:

* Plenty new games to play with your Star
* Bunch of new kinds of food that affect your Stars’ productivity and growth.
* New locations like MatchyMart and Zootlandia.
* Customization of your pet’s outfit and console.
* New Matchyverse characters and more!

This new game MatchyGotchy Z is right about to start the beta testing process so please reach out to us on Twitter or Facebook if you are a citizen of the Matchyverse who wants to join our beta crew! You can also follow up with this, and more at [url]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/silverwaregames/[/url]

We are so happy to create a fun inviting universe and the people who have been interacting with us as part of the community have made us so happy. We are sure that together we can make a wonderful universe for Matchy Star and friends that lasts for years and years! Of course these games are all inspired by the in development game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/782430/Matchy_Star/]Matchy Star which you can wishlist on steam right now by clicking here.[/url] HAVE FUN.

notes.title: Big MatchyGotchy Update Coming!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31716437/e7244a735437126b4629c0441f5d2700a3977093.jpg[/img]

There is more content coming for MatchyGotchy! We have had all sorts of feedback coming our way, both good and not so good and we have listened to all of it. One consistent request has been that we add more to the game. More food, more games and that’s why we decided to include more of everything! More cleaning, medicine options, and entertainment activities to do with your favorite star. We have also taken into consideration commentaries regarding how part of the experience can be improved and we are revising the difficulty curve of some achievements, as well as the pacing of the game. Considering this is a big update, we are working on a chunk of new content for an affordable DLC to complement what we already have – there will be updates found in the main build too, but most of the new content will be part of a DLC.

For example, we know a lot of people are looking for different games besides the guessing game and we are adding several more including ‘Hacky Sack’ which is a skill based game of clicking and timing. Also, we are including brand new fun things such as an in-game store to customize food and clothing, and ‘Ask the 8 Ball’ mini game to add more fun interactions with your star. There will be new kinds of food with different reactions, new locations including “Matchy Mart” to buy supplies and the “Fitting Room” to customize your pet’s duds.

Including this as a transaction, we can now add the Steam Cards we originally designed! Steam wouldn’t allow cards before because the game was entirely free. Either way, the original MatchyGotchy will continue to be free, this DLC is just an optional extra add on for the Matchyverse community that wants more from the game. If you get to play longer than and hour and want more, then there’s more for you to explore one download away.

If you would like to keep up with news on update, new releases, and even beta testing groups then sign up to our newsletter list.silverwaregames.com, and if you would love to reach out to us then you are welcome to follow us on twitter [url=https://twitter.com/swgspork] @swgspork [/url]   and [url=https://twitter.com/sayomgwtf] @sayomgwtf [/url]  

If you would like to read up more on this update, stop by our website to check out the full blog entry www.silverwaregames.com

notes.title: Leaderboard Verification
notes.notes:
Citizens of the Matchyverse!

We just updated MatchyGotchy to include a system to verify high scores. This means anyone who posts a fake score will be much more obvious to us behind the scenes and we should be able to remove them quickly.

For everyone who is having fun trying to get to the top of the leaderboard and playing MatchyGotchy as intended just update the game to the latest version and your score will be verified. 

If you see a suspicious score, please let us know and we'll remove it if we know it is fake. Have fun!

MatchyGotchy was born as a fun and cute idea, and after months of hard work, we are so happy to share that with all of you.

We've gone through 21 builds of the game in our beta testing process to bring you something fun, new, and intuitive. We've even made a manual you can download from the "View the manual" link in the bar on the right to explain exactly "How To Gotchy."

Please leave comments in the steam forums if you have any questions or want a new feature. We love to hear from players and we want to make this the best possible virtual pet for you so please leave feedback!
